name: Survey answer truth checker
why: Scores how far a survey can be trusted before you act on it, a useful check before writing the evaluation report.

name: Check a marketing survey before sending it
why: A bias review and pretest plan for any survey; the same checks apply to before-and-after programme surveys.

name: Prepare a survey findings briefing
why: A checked findings table with honest sampling caveats, matching the report skill's "how sure" line.

name: Nonprofit program outcome planner
why: Turns activities and a goal into a logic model with assumptions to check, the first step of the logic model skill.

name: Nonprofit program measurement planner
why: Picks measures, targets and dates and reports results with limits, alongside the measures and data plan skill.

name: Sample size planner
why: Works out how many people a comparison design would need, useful when a board asks for a trial.

name: Input metric picker
why: Separates the measures a team controls from the outcomes it reports, helpful when splitting monitoring from outcome measures.

name: Check training transfer after a course
why: Checks whether a course changed real work, for programmes that train staff or volunteers.

name: Grant spending evidence review assistant
why: Checks grant spending against award rules, the money side of the same funder report.

name: Prepare a grant spending evidence pack
why: Builds the reconciled spending table and evidence gaps to send with the funder summary.
